name: Milf for Hire
source:
Bella is 36, recently divorced, and starting over in a new city with nothing but a cleaning job and a son in college she can barely afford to support. When she's assigned to work at a wealthy family's mansion, she expects long hours and dirty floors. What she doesn't expect is how quickly the line between professional and personal begins to blur.

This is not a power fantasy. There are no shortcuts. MILF for Hire is built around realistic characters, natural dialogue, and choices that shape who Bella becomes — or who she loses herself to.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/milf-for-hire-v0-151216885]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
贝拉今年36岁，刚刚离婚，在一个新城市重新开始，除了一份清洁工作和一个正在上大学的儿子，她几乎无力抚养。当她被分配到一个富裕家庭的豪宅工作时，她预计工作时间会很长，地板也会很脏。她没想到的是，职业和个人之间的界限很快就开始变得模糊。

这不是权力幻想。没有捷径。《雇佣摩洛伊斯兰解放阵线》围绕真实的角色、自然的对话以及塑造贝拉成为什么样的人或她迷失的人的选择而建立。

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/milf-for-hire-v0-151216885]Patreon[/url]]
